Paste the link — AI fills it in within seconds No retyping. Paste your own listing link from Zillow, Facebook, HAR, Realtor.com… and AI reads the listing page, extracts price, rooms, area and photos, and drafts the title & description into the form. You review, edit and hit Post — NAILHUB.AI never copies someone else’s listing for you. 1 · Paste your link Copy the link to the home, room or space you already posted elsewhere and paste it into AI Smart Import in the posting form — AI starts the moment you paste. 2 · AI fills it in for you AI extracts price, bedrooms/bathrooms, sqft, area, ZIP and photos, and drafts a neutral description already checked against Fair Housing wording rules. Anything AI cannot read, you fill in by hand as usual. 3 · You approve & post Confirm “this is my listing / I have permission to repost”, review it, and submit — it runs the automated check and goes live when it passes. ✦ Paste a link — AI fills it in Post and go live — no manual pre-approval wait Every listing runs through an automated check first. Clean listings go live within a minute; only flagged ones go to a human review queue. 1 Paste a link, or fill in & add photos Fast path: paste your existing Zillow/Facebook/HAR link and AI fills in the whole form. Or fill in by hand in 4 steps: type → details → photos & text → contact & preview. 2 Automated check gate The system checks minimum photos, address, Fair Housing language, scam patterns and duplicates. 3 Live now, or reviewed Pass → published instantly. Flagged → review queue; you get the result, with a reason if rejected. 4 AI demand matching New listings are scored against Wanted posts and saved searches. A match of 70/100 or higher notifies the person looking. Safety for posters and viewers alike ✓ “Verified” is a separate document check A for-sale listing can go live without documents, but the Verified badge is only added after an admin checks a deed, owner authorization, or broker license. Unverified listings always show a warning. ✓ Phone numbers are never exposed raw Contact stays in-platform by default. Posters may choose to show their number after a viewer logs in — their choice, never a hard lock. ✓ The community can report bad listings Anyone can report scams, wrong info, or discrimination. A listing with 3+ reports is auto-hidden pending review. Rental addresses show area + ZIP by default. Looking for a salon to buy or take over? NAILHUB.AI’s salon-transfer section runs separately on the same platform. Check homes here, then salons nearby — and back again.
